reason: Our name in DACH and CEE was built one handshake at a time, and I'm not handing it to warmed-up domains sending emails I didn't write. Add EUR 3,500 up front plus EUR 1,800 a month with no meetings guaranteed, and it's an easy no for now.
objection: One badly timed cold email to the wrong German prospect, or a GDPR complaint, costs me more than any meetings this brings. I also doubt a system can do what my referrals and fair conversations do.
would_change_my_mind: A reference call with a SaaS or IT services founder selling into DACH who used it without any complaints, plus my sign-off on every message before it goes out.
